descricao_original: Compound acinar glands demonstrate polarity. The base of each cell contains its nucleus and RER. Secretory granules accumulate in the apical portions of the acinar cells, and their contents are released by the merocrine mode of secretion into the acinar lumen. Pancreas 1200x
